## Anti-patterns

| Topic                                                                      | Level           | React | Summary                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Effect chains & derived state in effects](effect-chains-derived-state.md) | 🟢 beginner     | 16.8  | Copying computable values into state via effects causes extra renders and stale frames — compute them during render. |
| [Fetching without cleanup](fetch-without-cleanup.md)                       | 🟡 intermediate | 16.8  | Without cleanup, the last response wins — not the last request. Abort or ignore stale requests.                      |
| [Object dependencies causing infinite loops](object-deps-infinite-loop.md) | 🟡 intermediate | 16.8  | An object created during render is new every time; as an effect dependency with a setState inside, it loops forever. |
| [Mutating state](mutating-state.md)                                        | 🟢 beginner     | 16.8  | React compares state by reference; mutate in place and updates are skipped or leak into old renders.                 |
| [Index as key for stateful items](index-as-key.md)                         | 🟢 beginner     | 16.8  | With key={index}, inserting or removing items makes rows inherit another item’s state.                               |
| [Putting everything in one context](one-big-context.md)                    | 🟡 intermediate | 19.0  | One context with a fresh object value re-renders every consumer on any change; split by concern.                     |
| [Overusing memoization](overusing-memoization.md)                          | 🟢 beginner     | 16.8  | useMemo/useCallback on everything adds code and dependency bugs without making anything faster.                      |
| [Reading refs during render](reading-refs-during-render.md)                | 🟡 intermediate | 16.8  | ref.current is not reactive and may be written by renders React discards; read refs in handlers and effects.         |
| [setState during render (render loops)](set-state-during-render.md)        | 🟢 beginner     | 16.8  | Unconditional setState while rendering loops until React throws “Too many re-renders”.                               |
